newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hochtief denies Deutsche link on Holzmann. [CORRECTED 09:11 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Hochtief denies Deutsche link on Holzmann. [CORRECTED 09:11 GMT]

text.p: German construction group Hochtief AG on Monday denied a magazine report it planned to "pool" its 20 percent (Corrects from 24.9 percent) stake with a similar size shareholding owned by Deutsche Bank in a bid to increase its control over fellow builder Philipp Holzmann AG.
"I was completely surprised to see this report," a Hochtief spokesman said, denying that any such deal had been planned.
Deutsche Bank has a stake of some 25.8 percent in Holzmann.

The spokesman added that Hochtief had been surprised at the German cartel authority's recent decision to delay hearings into plans by Hochtief and Holzmann to collaborate more closely, particularly on international projects, but that it was still preparing its case for the hearings.
Shares in Hochtief and Holzmann were both strongly higher despite the denial of the report, with Hochtief up three percent at 68 marks in pre-bourse trading and Holzmann 2.4 percent up at 430 marks.
